summary: Master IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance with our training course. Equip yourself with essential skills to manage GRC challenges in your organization.
lede: IT governance, risk and compliance connects technology decisions, risk treatment and control assurance to business objectives. This course is for professionals responsible for technology accountability, risk and compliance evidence across business and IT teams. It develops practical skills in prioritizing technology risks, mapping risks to controls and evidence, and reporting residual exposure to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This IT Governance, Risk and Compliance training suits professionals who coordinate technology accountability, risk treatment, control assurance, and compliance evidence across business and IT functions. It supports intermediate to advanced learners who already work with technology processes and need a more integrated GRC operating model.
modules: DAY 5: EXECUTIVE REPORTING AND GRC ROADMAP CAPSTONE
prerequisites: No coding or programming experience is required. Bring a laptop for digital risk-register, control-mapping, and dashboard exercises. You should have access to anonymized examples of technology risks, controls, audit findings, or compliance evidence if you want to adapt the exercises to your workplace. TrainingCred can provide sample datasets and templates for learners who cannot use organizational material.
